scope: Preserve unknown SCALE group-70 values on DXF read and refuse nonzero typed DXF output until the field meaning is established.

implementationReadiness.sourceObservation: DRW_Scale::parseCode retained group-70 values, but dxfRW::writeScale emitted any stored flag. The SCALE data member comment incorrectly described the value as always zero, which implied a known meaning rather than an unknown field.

normativeEvidence.source: Open Design Specification for .dwg files v5.4.1, §20.4.92 SCALE (AcDbScale), p. 221
normativeEvidence.relevantRule: The SCALE group-70 field is described as unknown; ODA writes 0. This does not establish semantics for other values.

implementationReadiness.change: DXF parsing continues to retain any group-70 value. Typed DXF writing now admits only zero and refuses nonzero values before emitting bytes. The public field comment now describes the field as unknown. No DWG parser/encoder code or callbacks changed.

coverage: ASCII and Binary readers retain a nonzero unknown group-70 field.
Typed ASCII and Binary writers emit group-70 zero and read it back as zero.
Typed ASCII and Binary writers refuse nonzero group 70 before emitting bytes.

limitations: Generated field handling only; no physical nonzero group-70 source or native consumer behavior was qualified.
Nonzero values remain readable but cannot be re-emitted through the typed SCALE DXF writer until their meaning is known.
No support claim is promoted; other SCALE version/API/root-graph and native annotation semantics remain open.
nextReadyPacket: Continue with an independently supported local P5/P6 gap; preserve and refuse unknown SCALE values rather than assign guessed semantics.
